query: Magnificent 7 tech companies (Alphabet, Amazon, Apple, Meta, Microsoft, Nvidia, Tesla) large acquisitions $10 billion or more announced or rumored in 2026, especially mid-2026. Any pending big M&A deals as of June-July 2026?
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the summary of findings on Magnificent 7 large acquisitions ($10B+) in 2026:

**Bottom line: No conventional $10B+ acquisition by a Mag 7 company was newly announced or credibly rumored specifically in June–July 2026.** The 2026 pattern is a deliberate shift away from outright M&A toward AI investments, acqui-hires/licensing, and multi-decade compute deals structured to avoid antitrust review.

**Largest deals in the 2025–2026 cycle:**
- **Alphabet/Google–Wiz** (~$32B announced, closed ~$29.5B, March 11, 2026) — largest acquisition in Google's history, cleared by DOJ/EU/others.
- **Nvidia–Groq** ($20B, Dec 2025) — a licensing + acqui-hire (not a formal acquisition), under Senate/FTC scrutiny through mid-2026 as an alleged antitrust workaround. This is the most significant large deal still under regulatory review during mid-2026.
- **Meta–Scale AI** ($14.3B for a 49% non-voting stake, June 2025).
- **Tesla** — undisclosed AI hardware firm (up to $2B, April 2026), below threshold.

**Mid-2026 (June–July) activity was partnership/capex-focused, not M&A:**
- Apple–Broadcom >$30B chip *supply* deal (~July 8)
- Meta Compute cloud business launch (July 1)
- Microsoft $2.5B internal AI unit (July 2)

**Rumored/denied:** An April 2026 report that Nvidia was negotiating to buy a large PC company (Dell/HP surged) was flatly denied by Nvidia.

key_facts: No conventional $10B+ acquisition by a Magnificent 7 company was newly announced or credibly rumored specifically in June–July 2026.

Alphabet/Google completed its acquisition of Wiz (cybersecurity) on March 11, 2026 for ~$29.5B (announced ~$32B) — the largest acquisition in Google's history — cleared unconditionally by DOJ, EU (Feb 10, 2026), and multiple other jurisdictions.

Nvidia's $20B Groq deal (announced Dec 24, 2025) is structured as a non-exclusive licensing agreement + acqui-hire, not a formal acquisition; it drew Senate (Warren/Blumenthal, March 2026) and FTC scrutiny as an alleged antitrust workaround and remained the most significant large deal under review during mid-2026.
Meta's $14.3B Scale AI deal (June 2025) bought a 49% non-voting stake, deliberately structured to avoid antitrust review.
Tesla disclosed (Q1 2026 10-Q, April 2026) an acquisition of an undisclosed AI hardware company for up to $2B in stock/equity awards (possibly DensityAI) — below the $10B threshold.
Apple announced a >$30B multi-year chip supply deal with Broadcom around July 8, 2026 (a supply commitment, not an acquisition), and reportedly a chipmaking deal with Intel.
Amazon announced up to $25B additional investment in Anthropic (April 20, 2026) plus $100B+ AWS commitment; Amazon also invested ~$50B in OpenAI with a ~$100B cloud deal.
The dominant 2026 M&A pattern among Mag 7 is minority stakes, licensing, acqui-hires, and multi-decade compute deals to sidestep antitrust review.
A rumor (April 13, 2026) that Nvidia was negotiating to acquire a large PC company (Dell surged 6.7%, HP hit intraday highs) was flatly denied by Nvidia.
Mid-2026 Mag 7 activity was partnership/capex-focused: Meta launched Meta Compute (July 1, 2026); Microsoft committed $2.5B and 6,000 employees to an AI implementation unit (July 2, 2026).
